title: Class-II source, translated model, balanced coefficient jets, and obstruction boundary
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 strict sharp cubes, exact Class-II algebra and independently executed fixtures close several invalid proof architectures without closing the Nelson theorem. The translation and universal-Q continuations prove the flexible epsilon_6<gamma/6 range, exact finite-cutoff translation/frame/Cartan identities, deterministic-shift expectation positivity, and the universal centered derivative-square tensor in every finite Lp(Omega;H^(-1-kappa)) with deterministic H2 Cameron-Martin continuity. Literal full XQ/XXQ products miss the advertised improved model regularities. The finite forest subproof exactly classifies the 2, 4+2, 5+2, and 3+0 Wiener contractions. The continuation A13-CLASSII-BALANCED-COEFFICIENT-JET-CONTINUUM-AND-A7-RECONSTRUCTION constructs high-against-root-shell P3/P4 jets, proves their coupled-cutoff convergence in every finite probability moment at H^(alpha-1-kappa) and H^(2alpha-1-kappa), and gives an exact second-order full-rational A7 covariance-normal reconstruction. It retains the finite Sigma_Lambda Q_Lambda term and every grouped lower-chaos correction. This does not close adapted random-shift control or the umbrella one-use theorem. The continuation A13-CLASSII-STRICT-PAST-RESOLVENT-SIGNED-CHARGE-REDUCTION proves exact strict-past causalization, retains the positive A11 shell block through the q-resolvent completion, and uses the A11 telescope to reduce one-use to sum_j[(q/2)<ell_j,R_q,j ell_j>-C_j], with q=10/9 at epsilon_v=0.45. The global production charge bound remains open.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-TRANSLATION-UNIVERSAL-Q-BALANCED-JET-AND-A7-RECONSTRUCTION-WITH-EXECUTED-NOGOS@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production symbol and coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact non-aliased Fourier products, common bounded entrywise-real-even scalar regulators with compact support or uniform Schwartz tails, covariance-matched A7 Wick subtraction, and the A10-A13 dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The balanced theorem uses high-against-root-shell homogeneous-chaos jets, no intermediate projection, alpha in (1/3,1/2), kappa>0 for jet convergence, and kappa<3 alpha-1 for rational reconstruction. The exact grouped chart retains every lower chaos; arbitrary individual localized correction-channel convergence, adapted random translation control, the signed one-use bound, and the umbrella gate remain open. The strict-past continuation is an exact finite ordered-Gaussian reduction with PSD T_j and A11 coefficient increments; it does not assert the cutoff-uniform global charge bound.
falsifier: A failure of any prior A13 Fierz, source, factor-four, one-use/Nelson, scalar-loop, nonfrozen determinant, potential, translation/frame, Cartan, expectation, universal-Q, or finite-forest assertion remains a falsifier. The balanced continuation is falsified by a wrong -2 or -3 Fourier-variance exponent, failure of coupled-cutoff Cauchy convergence at either target, failure of all-finite-moment hypercontractive lift, parenthesisation mismatch without an intermediate projection, omission of a P1/P2/P0 correction or the finite Sigma_Lambda Q_Lambda term, mismatch of the exact rational Taylor chart with the A7 covariance-normal composite, source/PDF hash mismatch, failed six-page PDF QA, failed primary/independent/integrated assertion, or a release-gate failure. The strict-past continuation is falsified by present/future dependence in a predictor, a wrong affine-divergence factor, loss of T_j positivity, a q other than (2 epsilon_v)^-1, a wrong resolvent sign, failure of delta a/2=sum I_j or delta(b-a)/2=sum C_j, deletion of the factor-four contribution inside shifted C_j, source/PDF hash mismatch, or a failed primary, independent, integrated, or release assertion.

reproduction.expected: Primary 9/9 and non-importing independent 9/9; both PASS sentinels; exit 0.

no_overclaim: The strict-past theorem is an exact causal/PSD-resolvent and A11 signed-charge reduction only. It preserves the relative-phase factor-four effect inside C_j and does not prove the cutoff-uniform global charge bound, the one-use inequality, q=10/9 Nelson moment, A11/A7 closure, an interacting measure, floor or regulator removal, infinite volume, phase transition, BCC selection, T5, T6, or T7.
